items.title: 3 Electronics Stocks Set to Benefit From a Prospering Industry

items.title: Garmin General Manager Sells $3.0 Million Stock Position
items.summary: Cheng-Wei Wang liquidated nearly a quarter of his direct holdings after the stock gained 28% over the past year. The insider retains 29,506 shares worth $8.78 million.

items.title: Dell Stock Is Daring You To Believe Its Numbers
items.summary: Management put a number on the board so big it forces a question, and the market is paying up as if it's a sure thing.

items.title: Companies Have Rarely Had Such Great Expectations
items.summary: Both earnings growth and the “surprise ratio,” the share of companies exceeding analyst expectations, are near historic highs.  What’s more important is how many companies are upbeat about the future.  Luckily, analysts at Bespoke Investment Group keep track of such things.

items.title: Garmin (GRMN) Stock Trades At A Premium To Fair Value
items.summary: Garmin stock is coming off a very strong three year run, yet both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market based valuation checks currently point to the shares trading at a premium to those fundamentals. Garmin has returned 219.8% over the past three years, which puts extra focus on whether the current price fully reflects its long term cash flow potential.
